name: generate_video
description: Generate AI videos with xAI Grok Video or Gemini Veo. Create videos from text prompts or images. Use when user says 'generate a video', 'create a video', 'make a video animation', 'animate this'. PROVIDERS: xAI Grok (default, 1-15s duration, more aspect ratios) or Gemini Veo (4-8s, native audio, up to 4K). Videos save to stash for use with other tools.

prompt.description: Detailed description of the video. Be specific about subject, action, movement, style, mood. For Gemini: Use quotes for dialogue, describe sound effects. Example: 'A cat playing with a ball, slow motion, cinematic lighting'

provider.description: Video provider: 'xai' (default, Grok Imagine Video - more duration options), 'gemini' (Veo 3.1 - native audio, higher resolution). If not specified, uses VIDEO_TOOL_PROVIDER from config.

duration.description: Video duration in seconds. xAI: 1-15 seconds (any value). Gemini: rounds to 4, 6, or 8 seconds. Default is 5 seconds.

aspect_ratio.description: Video shape. xAI supports all 7 options. Gemini only supports '16:9' (widescreen) or '9:16' (vertical) - others will be mapped.

resolution.description: Video resolution. xAI: '720p' or '480p'. Gemini: '720p', '1080p', or '4k' (1080p/4k only supports 8s duration).

image_url.description: URL of an image to generate video from (image-to-video). The image will be animated based on the prompt. Works with both xAI and Gemini.

video_url.description: XAI ONLY: URL of a video to edit. Maximum source video length is 8.7 seconds. The prompt describes the edit to make.

negative_prompt.description: GEMINI ONLY: What to avoid in the video. Example: 'cartoon, low quality, blurry'

save.description: Save to stash for use with other tools (default: true). Video is downloaded and stored locally.
